text: Searching millions of high-dimensional vectors linearly creates an unscalable bottleneck for AI applications.
Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs skip dense clusters like multi-tier highways across high-dimensional space.
The search hops across sparse upper layers before descending to the base for precise nearest neighbor convergence.
Balancing graph connectivity with construction depth is how production vector databases maintain sub-millisecond latency.
